title: Settling the Support Complexity of Correlated Equilibria
abstract: arXiv:2611.20362v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the support complexity of approximate correlated equilibria (CE) in two-player games, that is, the minimum number of pure action profiles that must be assigned positive probability to approximate a correlated equilibrium of a two-player matrix game. For $\varepsilon$-approximate coarse correlated equilibria, constant approximation is possible with support $O(\log N/\varepsilon^2)$ in $N\times N$ games. For correlated equilibria, the best known upper bound was $O(\log^2 N/\varepsilon^4)$ [Babichenko et al., 2014, 2017], but whether this bound was tight remained open. We establish a matching lower bound, resolving the open question of Ko and Schvartzman [2017]. translated_title: 确定相关均衡的支撑复杂度
translated_abstract: 我们研究两人博弈中近似相关均衡（CE）的支撑复杂度，即在近似两人矩阵博弈的相关均衡时，必须被赋予正概率的纯动作组合的最小数量。对于 ε-近似粗相关均衡，在 N×N 博弈中，大小为 O(log N/ε²) 的支撑即可实现常数近似。对于相关均衡，此前已知的最好上界为 O(log² N/ε⁴) [Babichenko 等，2014, 2017]，但该上界是否紧致仍是悬而未决的问题。我们建立了一个匹配的下界，从而解决了 Ko 和 Schvartzman [2017] 提出的开放问题。具体而言，我们证明，即使仅限于两人零和博弈，对于每个 1≤k≤N^(1/2)，由至多 k 个纯动作组合支撑的分布所能达到的最坏情形相关均衡差距为 Θ(min{1, √(log N)/k^(1/4)}。
tldr: 本文通过在两人零和博弈中建立匹配的下界，解决了相关均衡支撑复杂度的长期开放问题，证明已有的 O(log² N/ε⁴) 上界是紧致最优的。
en_tdlr: This paper settles the open question on the support complexity of correlated equilibria in two-player games by establishing a matching lower bound, proving that the previously known O(log² N/ε⁴) upper bound is tight.
